issues.summary: analyze_source.py emitted a malformed/truncated normalized PNG while the supplied JPEG decoded correctly
issues.evidence: source/source-001.png failed PIL load with image file is truncated; source/reference-01.jpeg decoded at 1536x864
issues.impact: palette and evidence operations cannot safely trust the normalized output
issues.workaround: used the original run-local JPEG for palette, source regions, panel coordinates and visual authority
issues.skill_feedback: add a byte-decodability gate immediately after normalization and block downstream stages when a normalized image cannot be fully loaded

issues.summary: requested chi_sim OCR language data was unavailable; installed languages were eng and osd
issues.impact: OCR cannot be treated as authoritative for Chinese formal text
issues.workaround: used GPT visual transcription, preserved visible punctuation and masked amount, and marked the outline transcription pending confirmation
issues.skill_feedback: surface unavailable OCR language as a formal degradation and require visual/human transcription review

issues.summary: generated frame rendered the lower-left panel border gray instead of the source green accent
issues.impact: panel-04 would visibly diverge from the reference
issues.workaround: repaired the generated blank panel asset border color and recorded the pre-repair asset; formal text remains excluded
issues.skill_feedback: add an accent-color replay check to frame/panel QA, not only alpha and geometry checks

issues.summary: source visibly contains the literal masked amount **元
issues.impact: silently inferring the hidden amount would fabricate business data
issues.workaround: kept **元 byte-for-byte in outline, layout and text manifests; highlighted in the report
issues.skill_feedback: keep literal redactions in semantic text checks and require explicit closeout confirmation

issues.summary: B5 helper paths are owned by GordenImage2PPTX while the ai-ppt-plus repository owns orchestration
issues.impact: relative skill-root commands can fail when copied between workflows
issues.workaround: used explicit GORDEN_SKILL_DIR and repository paths for every B5 command
issues.skill_feedback: document explicit skill-root variables in the reconstruction command examples

issues.summary: normalized PNG passed metadata inspection but failed complete pixel decoding
issues.impact: downstream OCR and image analysis could consume a corrupted source artifact
issues.workaround: blocked the normalized PNG with the new full-decode gate and used the verified run-local JPEG as visual authority
issues.skill_feedback: run validate_source_images.py immediately after normalization and block any non-decodable source

issues.summary: full-stream pdftoppm reported success while a rendered PNG could later be observed as truncated
issues.impact: a corrupt preview could be treated as a valid final render
issues.workaround: rendered each missing page through the verified selected-page path and reran the visual gate
issues.skill_feedback: make every published render page pass full decode verification before it is accepted

issues.summary: project validation required persisted handoff, validation report and issue log artifacts that were not scaffolded by the reconstruction run
issues.impact: all technical child gates could pass while the project aggregate failed
issues.workaround: created the three artifacts in the editable project directory without fabricating human sign-off
issues.skill_feedback: scaffold and validate required project-closeout artifacts before invoking the aggregate pipeline
